names.th: วักคาเนซูมิ

description.fun: Two tiny mice that stick together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and eat it together, and work as a team to gnaw off bits of anything that might make a good nest and carry them home. How they become a bigger family when they evolve is a mystery: the little ones just seem to appear out of nowhere.
description.guide: A Normal-type Pokémon made of two mice that act as one, designed by Megumi Mizutani. Tandemaus evolves into Maushold when it levels up during a battle.
description.tagline: Two mice that share everything, exactly half each

branches.text: Chance decides. Almost every Tandemaus becomes a Family of Four, but one in a hundred becomes a Family of Three, with only one little mouse. Japan's official Pokédex treats the rarer Family of Three as Maushold's main form.

names.th: อิกคาเนซูมิ

description.fun: A mouse family whose little ones just appeared one day, and nobody knows where from or how they're related. The larger pair protect the little ones in battle, but against a strong opponent the whole family joins in. They build huge nests with separate rooms for eating and sleeping. Its doll-like look may draw on Sylvanian Families figures.
description.guide: The evolution of Tandemaus, a Normal-type Pokémon made of a mouse family. It usually comes as a Family of Four, and rarely as a Family of Three.
description.tagline: A mouse family whose little ones just appeared one day

description.fun: The rare family with just one little one, which also simply appeared one day; they live together as a family, though how they're related is unclear. Only one Tandemaus in a hundred evolves into it.
